bluetooth_confirm.title: Add {name}?
bluetooth_confirm.description: Lockly GATTspeed controls this lock over Bluetooth. Next, sign in to your Lockly account once to fetch the lock's codes.

user.title: Choose a lock
user.description: Lockly locks Home Assistant can hear over Bluetooth.

cloud.title: Sign in to Lockly
cloud.description: Sign in with the Lockly account {name} is registered to. This is used once, to fetch the lock's codes. Your email, your password and the sign-in are not saved.

pick_lock.title: Which lock is {name}?
pick_lock.description: Your Lockly account has more than one lock. Pick the one you are adding.

error.cloud_auth: Lockly did not accept that email and password.
error.cloud_unreachable: Could not reach Lockly. Check the connection and try again.
error.cloud_no_locks: That Lockly account has no lock with usable codes.
error.cloud_bad_record: Lockly sent codes for this lock that could not be used.
error.cloud_wrong_lock: The lock did not accept those codes. They may belong to a different lock on your account.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the lock over Bluetooth. Move a Bluetooth radio or proxy closer to the lock and try again.

abort.already_configured: This lock is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This lock is already being set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Lockly lock is in range of Home Assistant's Bluetooth.
abort.unsupported_model: This lock model is not supported yet: {error}
